title: Ugly Story
plot_overview: A man becomes obsessively attached to a young woman who is in love with someone else. As he struggles with rejection, he descends into a dark psychological state, and his fixation leads to dangerous consequences.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re drawn to dark stories about obsession, rejection, and emotional turmoil; Not for you if you prefer lighter romances or stories with a reassuring tone.
review_summary: Pros: dark psychological premise; emotional tension | Cons: potentially intense themes; limited context available
